question: What responsibilities does the true teacher have toward the disciple in householder duties?
premises: The true teacher is the agent
The disciple is to be engaged in householder duties
The disciple is to be set forth in those duties
inference: The true teacher should engage and set the disciple forth in the duties of the householder stage.
plain_english: The true teacher should engage the disciple in the duties of the householder stage and set him forth in them.
